The current Global list is shown below with direct item database links. TAMING ITEM + TARGET 03 Taming Ring Buy the ring for 50,000 Zeny . It equips in the right accessory slot. /navi payon 175/131 Taming Ring #24966 → 04 Seal the egg Enchant Lv.1 uses one matching egg and is reported at 100% success , with a 10,000 Zeny fee. Lv.2 requires another matching egg and is reported at 50% success . PET COMPANION Hatch the egg A Pet Incubator awakens a pet from its egg. This is distinct from using the egg in the Taming Ring enchant process. Pet Incubator #643 → FEEDING & INTIMACY Feed your pet to build Intimacy After hatching a pet, keep it fed with its preferred Food. Pet Intimacy progresses through relationship stages, with Cordial and Loyal being the bonus reference stages shown in the catalogue below. Avoid unnecessary overfeeding. Exact numerical Hunger and Intimacy thresholds are not displayed here until they are confirmed for the current Ragnarok Zero Global client. Keep 1 Alcohol , 1 Detrimindexta and 1 Karvodailnirol in your inventory. With all three present, Louitz can tell you more about the solutions and sends you to Aure Dupon. The items are not consumed here. MINI MAP NPC IN GAME 2 QUEST STEP Aure Dupon geffen 181,114 Find Aure Dupon on the east side of Geffen, beneath the street light. Ask him about Morgenstein to learn where the researcher is located. MINI MAP NPC IN GAME 3 QUEST STEP Morgenstein geffen_in 141,140 Morgenstein is on the second floor of the old Blacksmith Guild building around Geffen's 5 o'clock position. Ask about his research first; afterwards, speak to him again to craft Mixture or Counteragent. A successful attempt increases the refinement level by +1. Official Guide ↗ Refine Simulator Failure can destroy the item.
